text: Mobile app development involves creating software for smartphones and tablets. A key part of this process is responsive design, which ensures that an app works well on different screen sizes. Developers must also choose between native and cross-platform development. Native apps are built for one specific platform, while cross-platform apps can run on both Android and iOS. Once an app is ready, it is usually published on app stores like Google Play or the App Store. However, performance is a major concern, as users expect fast, smooth apps that do not crash or lag.
